title: All corrected odd-open and even-closed XOR-magic degrees at powers of two
exact_endpoint: XorMagic.corrected_all : ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → CorrectedAt n; XorMagic.not_printed_each_ge_four : ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → ¬ PrintedAt n (also printed_not_all, printed_not_positive)
scope: Cichacz-Grochowski-Zuazua Conjecture 25 (arXiv:2512.19278) as printed is false at every n>=4 because closed degree 2^n-4 is excluded by Proposition 24 (Batal); that correction is zero-credit. The intended conjecture (MathDB: 'apart from the degrees excluded by the previously stated nonexistence result') is proved in full: for every n>=4 there are connected simple open zero-XOR graphs on 2^n vertices of every odd degree 5..2^n-5 and closed ones of every even degree 4..2^n-6, which with Proposition 24 is the complete existence picture for the odd-open and even-closed classes.
source_targets: S. Cichacz, H. Grochowski, R. Zuazua, arXiv:2512.19278v1 Conjecture 25
substantive_reason: Completes the existence picture posed as the source's only conjecture for every power of two, via a new four-fold affine F4 lift (2-colouring orientation, translation choice by a cardinality argument, fibre-size connectivity), block interpolation and complements; the source and Batal had only scattered degrees.
novelty_standard: Qualified bounded comparison; Batal DAM 2026 body unread (publisher 403, repository challenge), but Batal posed the existence question as open; not worldwide priority
remaining_literature_limits: Batal, Discrete Applied Mathematics 379 (2026) 288-315 body unread
trust_limits: base graphs found by optimizer search, verified exactly by kernel decide
